bio.text: Mark Tedford, a Republican, is a candidate for Oklahoma's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election and has represented District 69 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives since November 23, 2022.

He earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri Southern State University in 1992 and graduate degrees from the University of Tulsa in 1994 and Biola University in 2013; his career experience includes working as a businessman.
Oklahoma Voice reported that he owns Tedford Insurance and was first elected to the state House in 2022.
